members.name: finalize
members.doc: Class for finalization of weakrefable objects finalize(obj, func, *args, **kwargs) returns a callable finalizer object which will be called when obj is garbage

members.name: getweakrefcount
members.doc: Return the number of weak references to 'object'.

members.name: getweakrefs
members.doc: Return a list of all weak reference objects pointing to 'object'.

members.name: KeyedRef
members.doc: Specialized reference that includes a key corresponding to the value. This is used in the WeakValueDictionary to avoid having to create a function object for ea

members.name: proxy
members.doc: Create a proxy object that weakly references 'object'. 'callback', if given, is called with a reference to the proxy when 'object' is about to be finalized.

members.name: WeakKeyDictionary
members.doc: Mapping class that references keys weakly. Entries in the dictionary will be discarded when there is no longer a strong reference to the key. This can be used t

members.name: WeakMethod
members.doc: A custom `weakref.ref` subclass which simulates a weak reference to a bound method, working around the lifetime problem of bound methods.

members.name: WeakValueDictionary
members.doc: Mapping class that references values weakly. Entries in the dictionary will be discarded when no strong reference to the value exists anymore
